subject: Eval sprint MAP & asset handoff — schedule and usage checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Kim <leah.kim@novumai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval sprint MAP proposal + initial asset handoff checklist

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I've put together a short mutual action plan for the evaluation sprint and an initial checklist for the assets NovumAI will share for the accuracy and latency tests. High level ask: can we receive the prompt pack and the agreed sample testcases by Aug 18 so Redwood can complete ingest, run baseline passes, and report back by Aug 29?

Proposed sprint milestones (compressed):
- Aug 10: NovumAI finalizes prompt pack and test manifest
- Aug 18: Secure transfer of assets (SFTP or encrypted transfer) + MD5 manifest
- Aug 19–25: Redwood ingest + baseline runs (staging)
- Aug 26–29: Result review, quality regressions check, joint sync

Usage constraints we need you to confirm:
1) Assets are provided solely for evaluation purposes; no retention beyond 90 days without written permission.
2) No redistribution outside evaluation team.
3) Anonymization: you confirm PII is scrubbed from provided prompt/test items (or flag items that contain PII).

Attached: eval-manifest-v1.csv (schema + sample filenames), and a draft MAP (redwood-MAP-draft-20250803.pdf) with acceptance criteria.

Could you confirm the transfer method you prefer (SFTP credentials, AWS presigned link, or secure SharePoint) and whether Legal should sign the short MPA we attached? If the schedule above looks ok we will open the HubSpot deal RDW-8237-NOV and send a DocuSign for the MAP.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Leah Kim <leah.kim@novumai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovumAI Legal <legal@novumai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval sprint MAP proposal + initial asset handoff checklist

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the clear milestones — this looks reasonable. NovumAI can deliver the prompt pack and the testcase manifest by Aug 17 to give you an extra day for ingestion. A few quick notes:

- Retention: we can agree to 90 days retention for evaluation artifacts; any extension needs a written request (Legal review).
- PII: the current pack has a handful of fields with potential PII. We will scrub and provide a redaction map and mark items that remain (internal flagging column in the manifest).
- Transfer: SFTP works best for us. We will provide a temporary account and an MD5 manifest; if you prefer presigned S3 links we can do that as well.

I've looped in Legal (copied) to expedite the short MPA. If Legal can sign the version you attached, that will speed things up.

I'll aim to get the assets to you on Aug 17 and send SFTP details by EOD Aug 12.

Best,
Leah
Leah Kim | Product Ops, NovumAI
leah.kim@novumai.com | +1 (206) 555-0104

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Eval sprint MAP proposal + initial asset handoff checklist

Folks — forwarding NovumAI's confirmation. Can you take these action items?

Action items:
- Marissa: please review the MAP draft (attached) and confirm whether we need to add any additional usage limits (e.g., evaluation-only watermarking, token logging retention windows) before sending DocuSign.
- Dylan: prep a temporary SFTP user and a small intake playbook (steps for MD5 validation, ingestion path, expected schema transformation). We expect multiple small files (promptpack-novum-v2.zip + manifest).

Quoted for context:
> On 2025-08-03 11:06, Leah Kim <leah.kim@novumai.com> wrote:
> > Hi Irene —
> > 
> > Appreciate the clear milestones — this looks reasonable. NovumAI can deliver the prompt pack and the testcase manifest by Aug 17 to give you an extra day for ingestion.
>
I'll draft the HubSpot note and generate the DocuSign envelope once Marissa gives the green light on the MPA wording.

Thanks —
Irene

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Eval sprint MAP proposal + initial asset handoff checklist

Irene / Marissa —

Got it. I'll stand up a temporary SFTP account on our intake host (sftp.eval.redwood.ai). Notes:
- Directory: /incoming/novumai/RDW-8237/
- Will enforce chroot and key-based auth; will expire account after 14 days by default (we can extend to 90 days if Legal requests retention).
- Intake steps (short): validate MD5s, unzip promptpack to staging, run light normalization (utf-8, newline canonicalization), run a schema check against eval-manifest-v1.csv, then kick off the baseline job (small cluster).

Attachments I'll push to you internally: promptpack-novum-v2.zip sample + a tech-runbook stub. Also adding required config for ingestion (ingest-config.yaml) to the shared drive.

If Legal insists on an encrypted transfer via presigned S3 rather than SFTP we can support that — both options are fine. Once Marissa confirms the MPA wording I'll trigger the DocuSign creation.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

From: Leah Kim <leah.kim@novumai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovumAI Legal <legal@novumai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-04T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval sprint MAP proposal + initial asset handoff checklist

Thanks everyone — this plan works for us. A couple of final confirmations before we start transfer tomorrow:

1) We will provide the promptpack-novum-v2.zip and an MD5 manifest to the SFTP path you specified by Aug 17 EOD.
2) NovumAI Legal will review the redwood-MAP-draft-20250803.pdf and send a single redline if needed by Aug 12; otherwise we will proceed with the DocuSign version you provide.
3) Retention: NovumAI confirms evaluation-only, 90-day retention is acceptable; we will expect automatic removal of the assets unless an extension is requested via the HubSpot deal.

I've uploaded a redaction map and a short README into the promptpack (see filenames inside the zip). Leah (NovumAI) will reply with SFTP credentials tomorrow morning.

Looking forward to the run — please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Leah Kim
Product Ops, NovumAI
